id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataStorePathForEnumOptions.description:
The key to the enum options in the {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap}.
The {@link UiApDataStore} is specified by {@link #dataStoreId}.
This key is used to retrieve the available enum options for the field.

dataStorePathForCurrentValue.description:
The key in the {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap} that points to the current value of the enum field for the entity.
This value is used to display the currently selected option in the dropdown.
The {@link UiApDataStore} is specified by {@link #dataStoreId}.

dataStorePathForUpdateValue.description:
The key in the {@link UiApDataStore#actionMap} that specifies the action to update the enum field value for the entity.
This action is triggered when the user selects a new value from the dropdown.
The {@link UiApDataStore} is specified by {@link #dataStoreId}.

fieldName.description: The name of the enum field within the entity that will be updated.

dataStoreId.description: The data store id to use for the enum updater.

translationKey.description: The translation key prefix for enum option display texts.

placeholder.description: The placeholder text to display in the dropdown when no value is selected.
